mentions.text: Vanguard is now the biggest ETF issuer in the United States overtaking BlackRock

JPMORGAN, BLACKROCK AND GOLDMAN TO TOKENIZE STOCKS, TREASURYS

The Depository Trust & Clearing Corp a leading trade processor, plans to convert a batch of shares and Treasurys into digital tokens

Almost 40 financial firms and tech providers, from JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs to BlackRock, Vanguard and the New York Stock Exchange, will take part in a trial run to tokenize securities that Wall Street firms keep at DTCC

The assets set to tokenize in Wednesday’s process include shares of Microsoft, Circle , Invesco QQQ, State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust and iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF

DTCC plans to launch its tokenization program formally in October

(Source Bloomberg)
